note: boots: the arm at the platform default, the same binary with revocation off, and (when --eager) a third at every-free. The default is the only one a verdict comes from; off is what attributes a fault, since a purecap SIGPROT carries no symbol here; eager only separates a quarantined-but-never-reissued chunk from a genuine miss, and is recorded in the notes rather than scored

platform.cpu_flags: the machine default: no -cpu override (see qemu_argv)

scoring.attribution: the paired boot of the same binary with security.cheri.runtime_revocation_default=0: a fault that appears there too is not revocation's and is recorded as such. A declared fault site is not required, because this arm has no symbols for one
scoring.gate: sensitivity: the same observations with that gate lifted, scored by fault site. Reported BESIDE the default reading and never instead of it (bug-corpora/php/engine-repros pre-registration); the two bundles are written from ONE set of boots, so nothing differs but the scoring
